forest.title: Bear Woods
forest.lead: Gather mushrooms and the 5 lost pieces in the dusky woods. If a bear spots you, run! Hide! The dock and the camp are safe.
forest.howto: Left: stick (inside the ring walks; drag out to the outer ring to sprint) · right: drag the camera · act: hide/climb/push/help · seed: a pitfall
forest.down: Fainted… {s}s for a partner to help
forest.watching: Back at the airport. Watch your partner
forest.sentHome: Carried to the airport… “That was close…”
forest.trapped: A bear fell in the pitfall!
forest.swarmed: The wasps went for the bear!
